literal: To those who have reached the feet of Him who has no comparison to Himself, except, dispelling mental anxiety is difficult.
translation: Except for those who hold fast to the feet of the One who has no equal, it is difficult to dispel the anxieties of the mind.
modern: தனக்கு ஒப்புமை இல்லாத இறைவனுடைய திருவடிகளைப் பற்றிக் கொண்டவர்களுக்கே அன்றி, மற்றவர்களுக்கு மனக்கவலையை நீக்குவது கடினம்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the path to overcoming mental suffering. The supreme being is described as having no equal or comparison, representing absolute perfection. The feet symbolize surrender, devotion, and seeking refuge. The poet asserts that unless one surrenders to this incomparable supreme power, it is impossible to dispel the deep-seated anxieties of the human mind.
